name: Nebai
title: Co-signer of the covenant
summary: Nebai is a person mentioned in the book of Nehemiah as one of the leaders among the people who placed their seal on the covenant with God after returning from exile in Babylon. He is among those who committed themselves to follow God's law and remain separate from the surrounding nations. Little else is known about him beyond this role as a co-signer.

keyEvents.title: Sealing of the covenant
keyEvents.description: Nebai was one of the leaders of the people who placed his seal on the covenant to follow God's law, as it was renewed under the leadership of Nehemiah and Ezra in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: The people's commitment to the law
keyEvents.description: Together with others who sealed the covenant, Nebai committed himself to walk according to God's law, which was given through Moses, and to keep all the Lord's commands, statutes, and laws.

keyEvents.title: Promise not to intermarry with foreign peoples
keyEvents.description: As part of the covenant, Nebai joined the people in promising not to give their daughters in marriage to the foreign peoples in the land or to take their daughters as wives for their sons.

keyEvents.title: Promise to keep the Sabbath holy
keyEvents.description: The covenant included a commitment to keep the Sabbath holy and not to buy goods from foreign peoples on the Sabbath day or other holy days.
